items.category: Software build tools (packaging, makefiles, et. al.)
items.synopsis: Enhanced subscriber management might not work when Junos is installed using USB image
items.description: On all Junos platforms, USB installation fails to bring up subscriber daemons while installing Junos via USB. Subscriber daemons keep crashing and never bring up subscribers. It impacts enhanced subscriber management services.

items.synopsis: JSD crash during cBNG container startup or restart from CLI from within a cBNG container
items.description: During startup of a cBNG container or when JSD is restarted from the CLI in a cBNG container, JSD might crash creating a core dump. JSD should recover from the crash and automatically restart. JSD should function normally after recovering from the crash.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss may be observed when changing firewall configuration
items.description: On MX platforms supporting MPC7/8/9 line cards, traffic loss may be observed if the firewall configuration changes are made when PFE 0 (Packet Forwarding Engine) is in a disabled state. It is a rare occurrence.

items.synopsis: After activating EVPN-ETREE service on ACX5448 pfe may crash
items.description: On ACX5448 platform after add some EVPN-ETREE services/interfaces the riofeb (pfe) process may crash and 'dnx_rt_vpls_rebake_flood_route' and 'dnx_nh_composite_handle_flood_nh_change' logs will be seen. "show vmhost crash" will show riofeb coredumps.

items.synopsis: Packet loss might be seen on SRX4100 and SRX4200 devices from 20.2R2
items.description: Packet loss might be seen on SRX4100 and SRX4200 devices from 20.2R2

items.category: Report install issues on BSDX (Occam) images
items.synopsis: JDI-RCT:M/Mx: errors spew on junos upgrade @ rm: //opt/sdk/service-packages/...: is a directory
items.description: A harmless error from activation of jservices packages

items.category: Issues related to Junos Automation, Commit/Op/Event and SLAX
items.synopsis: A large configuration might not get committed at boot
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved, the mgd process might fail to commit a scaled configuration (~350K set statement) during boot due to insufficient memory.

items.category: Issues related to mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL infrastructure, Juno
items.synopsis: Config error after upgrade when modifying group for lsp auto-bandwidth /config/juniper.conf:164:(39) syntax error: adjust-interval
items.description: Config error after upgrade when modifying group for lsp auto-bandwidth /config/juniper.conf:164:(39) syntax error: adjust-interval.

items.category: Covers Application classification workflows apart from custo
items.synopsis: The srxpfe process might crash while installing IDP sigpack with scaled traffic on SRX platforms
items.description: On SRX platforms, while installing IDP(Intrusion Detection and Prevention) sigpack in a loop (installing private IDP sigpacks for particular versions alternatively) srxpfe process might crash.

items.synopsis: ISIS adjacency is not coming up through TCC l2circuit
items.description: On ACX/PTX/QFX platforms(PTX10002/10003/10008/10016/QFX10002/10003/10008/10016/ACX6360) if protocols l2circuit and channel tcc is enabled for providing layer 2 transaction, ISIS connection through the layer 2 domain might get failed and traffic loss might be seen.

items.synopsis: SRX1500: Traffic fail seen on irb interface for network control forwarding class when verifying dscp classification based on single and multiple code-points
items.description: Traffic drop might be seen on irb interface on SRX1500 for network control forwarding class when verifying dscp classification based on single and multiple code-points.

items.synopsis: SRX_RIAD:s rx1500,srx4200: SKYATP: IMAP/IMAPS Email permitted counter is not incremented in AAMW email statistics while testing whole email block.
items.description: The SKYATP:IMAP/IMAPS Email permitted counter may have incorrect value under certain conditions.

items.category: platform related PRs on SRX branch platforms
items.synopsis: Netbios traffic (IRB broadcast) is getting dropped post upgrade on the SRX platform
items.description: On SRX platforms, NetBIOS (Network Basic Input/Output System) packets originating from the client do not reach the server as it is being dropped on the device after the upgrade.
